hook: TGSRTC's new weekly pass: unlimited AC bus rides for *₹600*
hook_b: Ride Hyderabad's AC buses all week for *₹86 a day*?
tldr: From today (Oct 25), TGSRTC sells a ₹600 weekly pass for all its AC buses in Hyderabad's core urban region, valid 7 days. Pushpak airport buses are not included.

beats.what: TGSRTC launched a weekly pass for ₹600. It works on all its AC buses within the Core Urban Region (CURE) for seven days from purchase.
beats.why: TGSRTC says it wants more people on public transport. Daily commuters, tourists and short business visitors no longer need a ticket for every trip.
beats.care: Ride AC buses most days? ₹600 works out to about ₹86 a day. Add up your normal week of tickets before you buy. Airport trips on Pushpak don't count.

cards.body: TGSRTC MD Y Nagi Reddy announced it. You buy it at any city bus pass counter. It fills the gap between the existing daily and monthly passes.

cards.caption: validity, counted from the day you buy
cards.body: Not a calendar week. Buy on Wednesday, it runs to next Tuesday.

cards.q: Would you buy a ₹600 weekly AC bus pass?
opts: No, metro or bike for me

cards.q: Which AC bus is NOT covered by the weekly pass?
cards.why: Pushpak airport buses are excluded; other TGSRTC AC buses in CURE limits are covered.

viz.l: weekly pass, all TGSRTC AC buses (except Pushpak)
per day if you use it all 7 days

learn.t: CURE (Core Urban Region) is the inner Hyderabad zone inside the Outer Ring Road used for city planning and bus pass limits.

watch: Whether TGSRTC adds a weekly option for ordinary and Metro Express buses too, and how the Metro-bus common pass price review lands.
